model_annotation: The chart presents data on enterprises, employment, and net turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021, as a percentage of the sector in the total economy, with absolute values by NACE Rev. 2. It is divided into three pie charts, each representing a different aspect: the number of enterprises, the number of persons employed, and turnover. The first pie chart shows the number of enterprises, with four slices representing different industries: construction (61% or 19.0 million), trade (19% or 5.9 million), other services (8% or 2.4 million), and the remaining 12% not specified. The second pie chart illustrates the number of persons employed, with construction employing the largest share at 51% (80.2 million), followed by trade at 19% (29.5 million), other services at 9% (13.4 million), and the remaining 21% not specified. The third pie chart depicts turnover, with construction again having the largest share at 33% (10.6 trillion), followed by trade at 31% (9.9 trillion), other services at 6% (1.9 trillion), and the remaining 31% not specified. Each pie chart includes a legend indicating the color coding for each industry, and the percentages are labeled inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
